The verified 18.91 is worn with a modelled O7 ball-link socket. The catalogue M2 ball link (igus KBRM-02 / KBLM-02, head O9 x 4) pinches hub 2 past dK ~35.4 (red team finding 2), and the taken K opening reaches 37.8 deg on the bench and 38.5 held out. Worn through the model unchanged with r_h 15.5 and the drive range capped at dK 35.4 (the build spec's stop B): frozen exact Bench(110,360) 19.76 (score 92.81) / 1 mm 20.85 / 2 mm 34.39, held out 23.53 / 26.63 / 37.95. That is +0.85 plain, +0.85 at 1 mm, +0.36 at 2 mm and +0.86 held out against 18.91 / 20.00 / 34.03 / 22.67. 3 bench poses and 10 held-out poses are lost, none overhead. The r_h 15.5 control without the cap gives 18.92 (red team 18.92). The 18.91 stands only if a custom O7 x 3 crank-tip eye is built and the horn eye clears hub K's real dome by >= 1 mm, neither of which has been built or judged yet. HANDOFF and the dashboard show 18.91 with no buildable-drive caveat. Not gamed: at 2 mm it still beats parallelogram (50.14) and frontload (43.98), and it does not pass anything the wearer would prefer. The verified reading puts the stops exactly on the rule. smlo is 5.0, and a1max is 63.1774, exactly bk1 + bk2 - 5. No build tolerance is applied, and the min th margin over taken poses is 5.232. Its priced reading (J2 stops +0.5, CB_FOLD_MARGIN 5.5, the minarc judge's pricing) is 19.36 / 20.45 / 34.63, held out 23.29. The 4-active leads it is compared with carry that pricing: minarc pick1 18.40 and BDp 19.54 (+0.48 priced). HANDOFF's 'the best 3-active design is now within 0.51' compares an unpriced number with a priced one. Priced, the gap is 0.96, and priced together with the catalogue drive it is about 1.8, which is not measured as a combined wear. The ranking order does not change. The metal hugs the skin where the goal cares most, overhead. The probe re-wear (identical to the 20:37 probe) finds 8 of 10 overhead clip frames (elev >= 140) and 5 of 8 taken overhead workspace poses with metal < 2 mm, 1 of them < 1 mm. The 10th-percentile overhead min metal is 1.02 mm on the bench and 0.64 mm held out. 15.12 gap points live in the 1-2 mm shell on the bench (20.00 -> 34.03) and 11.49 held out (25.75 -> 37.24). Below the 25-point gamed line. It still beats every verified 3-active row at 2 mm. [evidence: docs/alignment/remeasure/sidecar-longdyad-knuckle-3r_probe.json (clip_overhead140, ws_overhead140); docs/alignment/remeasure/sidecar-longdyad-knuckle-3r_bench.json / _held.json deep.overhead_min_metal_p10, gap_near1 / gap_near2]

The drive's contact is held only by K's clock spring (0.08 N.m preload, which closes the train horn -> rod -> crank -> roller -> lobe). Lift-off above about 30 rad/s2 of q2 acceleration is gen-5's estimate, not measured on this drive. R17 with the new slaved-coordinate coupling (judge/dynamics.py, commits 5d6b819 / 9f28755: force closure with lift-off) has not run on this design, and gen-6's L1 is still building. The J2 step the wearer feels at the onset is 0.13-0.20 N.m (red team, virtual work). The verified number assumes K exactly on the law.
